81:t_1:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

81:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whoa... So you've been fighting those 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 all along, Big Bro $$レド$$?」

81:t_1:5.en:
$$レド$$
「My service time is only 145,000 hours.」

81:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Uh... 145,000 hours, and there's 24 hours in a day, so...」

81:t_1:8.en:
$$恵子$$
「Then you've been in the military ever since you were born?」

81:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「...The $$人類銀河同盟$$'s primary objective is to annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

81:t_1:10.en:
$n
「So, for its people, living means serving as soldiers...」

81:t_1:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's intense. You've literally been on the battlefield since birth.」

81:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's exactly why you need to broaden your horizons.」

81:t_1:14.en:
$$レド$$
「That's why I decided to accompany you.」

81:t_1:15.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's a shame... If things were more peaceful, you could go to school and join our $$ボランティア部$$, $$レド$$.」

81:t_1:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「The $$ボランティア部$$? What's that?」

81:t_1:17.en:
$n
「We're a team that serves society with goodwill and a spirit of service, for the public good... and for school credits.」

81:t_1:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Mostly, we pick up trash, though.」

81:t_1:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's so lame. I'm not doing any of that.」

81:t_1:21.en:
$n
「That's all right, $$勝平$$. I'll teach you how much fun picking up trash can be.」

81:t_1:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「I-I'll pass...! You're scaring me, Big Bro $n!」

81:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But doing things for other people is admirable. Right, $$レド$$?」

81:t_1:24.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't really understand it. All I've ever done is fight.」

81:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's hard to explain the spirit of service. It's a little different from doing things to survive...」

81:t_1:26.en:
$n
「That's why I think it's uniquely human. In other words, goodwill and the spirit of service are what make us human.」

81:t_1:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Nicely put, $n. You're more than just a trash-picking enthusiast.」

81:t_1:28.en:
$$マオ$$
「The quiet type, trash-picking enthusiast, older-woman magnet... You've got all kinds of titles, $n.」

81:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Hold on, $$マオ$$. What's this about an older-woman magnet...?」

81:t_1:30.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't be shy, $n. Nurses and lady teachers are every man's dream.」

81:t_1:31.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クルツ$$...! Please don't drag the nurse and me into your personal fantasies.」

81:t_1:32.en:
$$マオ$$
「Give him a break, Miss $$スズネ$$. Apparently, he's got some bittersweet memories of a lady teacher.」

81:t_1:33.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sis...! How did you know about that...!?」

81:t_1:34.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, well... I was fishing, and I hit a hole in one. Now I've got something to keep me entertained until we reach $$アメリア$$.」

81:t_1:35.en:
$$勝平$$
「Oh! Are we talking about your first love, Big Bro $$クルツ$$!?」

81:t_1:36.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you like lady teachers that much, I'll introduce you to Miss $$美重子$$.」

81:t_1:38.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I don't think Mr. $$大門$$, the kendo expert, would take that lying down, though.」

81:t_1:39.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A rival in love just gets me fired up! Right, $$カナメ$$?」

81:t_1:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why are you dragging me into this!?」

81:t_1:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...They're a lively bunch, huh, $$レド$$?」

81:t_1:43.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you having trouble fitting in?」

81:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「I heard $c was part of a military organization. But it's nothing like the military I know...」

81:t_1:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's understandable. To a regular army, we must look like an undisciplined band of thugs.」

81:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we're human beings before we're soldiers. Outside the battlefield, we simply live as we please.」

81:t_1:47.en:
$$レド$$
「We're human beings before we're soldiers... huh...」

81:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「You may find that hard to grasp, since being human meant being a soldier to you.」

81:t_1:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「Though I only started to really understand it myself over the past year.」

81:t_1:50.en:
$$レド$$
「Will I understand it someday, too?」

81:t_1:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「But you have the potential. That's why we accepted you.」

81:t_1:54.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's do our best, $$レド$$. I'll work hard with the living support crew, too.」

81:t_1:56.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But we've got a rough road ahead. A huge showdown with $$サイデリアル$$ awaits us on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

81:t_1:57.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't worry, Big Bro $$クルツ$$. $$サイデリアル$$ or $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, they're no match for us if we join forces.」

81:t_1:60.en:
$$レド$$
「You don't understand how terrifying the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are.」

81:t_1:61.en:
$$勝平$$
「You say that, but we've fought enemies we couldn't talk to, where it was kill or be killed.」

81:t_1:62.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「About that... Could the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ be $$バアル$$, too?」

81:t_1:64.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's a term for humanity's natural enemies we can't talk to. As $$ワッ太$$ says, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ for survival are probably a type of 《$$バアル$$》.」

81:t_1:65.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$, $$インベーダー#robot$$... Those damn pests are everywhere.」

81:t_1:66.en:
$$レド$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$...! They're even out here on the fringes of the galaxy!?」

81:t_1:67.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You know about the $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

81:t_1:68.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes... They're enemies of the Alliance, just like the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

81:t_1:69.en:
$n
「I heard that in $$ノリコ$$'s world, the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest was at the center of the galaxy...」

81:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is that where their nest is in this world, too...?」

81:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$バアル$$... They're humanity's natural enemies, swarming whenever the universe is reborn in its 12,000-year cycle...」

81:t_1:72.en:
$$マオ$$
「Apparently, they and $$サイデリアル$$ are lurking around the center of the galaxy.」

81:t_1:73.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The universe is so huge, and it's still full of fighting...?」

81:t_1:74.en:
$n
「The center of the galaxy seems to be a particularly fierce war zone.」

81:t_1:75.en:
$$レド$$
(As $n said, various factions fought for dominance and survival at the center of the galaxy...)

81:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
(It's strange, now that I think about it... In this vast universe, all the fighting seemed to be concentrated there...)

81:t_1:80.en: ～ $$レイクサイド・ダイナーズ$$ ～

81:t_1:82.en:
$$店長$$
「That's the fifth plate you've broken.」

81:t_1:83.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Gravity beat me again... Six hours at 760 en an hour... Minus the five plates I broke today, a whole day's work comes to... um... 220 en...」

81:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Damn you, $$ニュートン$$! I'll never forgive you! $$ノノ$$ will pick up the fallen apple, so could you pretend gravity never existed?」

81:t_1:85.en:
$$店長$$
「You ate an apple we were selling... That'll be 150 en.」
